title: Split the new-pane button into New Terminal and New Claude
notes: Shipped in #228: the title row's new-pane button is New Terminal | New Claude. New Claude (terminal-add-claude, Ctrl+Shift+A) opens a worker pane as a Claude screen of yours in the project folder, empty until the first prompt, run in the screen host and back on its conversation after a restart. /clear, /resume, /branch and /rewind act on its own conversation; it reports to nobody.
